description_en: Apartment for sale in Univers City 530191062-80 - Located in one of the most developed areas of the city, very close to the QTU shopping center, the "Univers City" complex is the largest urban project in Tirana with guaranteed success, built by one of the most renowned companies in the market. - Univers City consists of buildings with various residential and service units as well as complete infrastructure for a comfortable living in a residential community. - The apartment is of the typology 2+1+2 TOILET, with a total area of ​​105.99m2, a perfect layout and regular organization, where the entrance is made through a distribution corridor to the living room, the 2 bedrooms, one of which has a bathroom inside, two balconies.
